storage.organizationSecret: Optional only if organization policy supports private repositories; restrict visibility to this repository

credential.preferredType: GitHub App installation token or fine-grained credential supported by the organization audit-log endpoint
credential.fallbackType: Classic PAT with read:audit_log, issued to an organization owner and approved by organization policy
credential.ownerRequirement: The identity must be an organization owner if required by the audit-log endpoint
credential.repositoryAccess: Selected repository only where the chosen credential type supports repository restriction

organization.administration: read, if the organization audit-log endpoint exposes this permission for the selected account and plan

githubActionsBuiltInToken.purpose: Repository-events fallback only; it is not equivalent to organization audit-log access

fullCoverage.tokenSource: GH_TOKEN sourced from the repository secret

validation.apiProbe: GET /orgs/create-well/audit-log with a narrow repo phrase and a bounded since timestamp
validation.workflowCheck: Confirm full-coverage mode only when the secret is present; otherwise expect an explicit reduced-coverage warning
validation.rotationCheck: Revoke the prior credential and confirm the next scheduled run succeeds with the replacement
validation.incidentTrigger: Treat an unexpected 401, 403, token-use event, or secret-access event as an investigation signal
